Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished opaque cinematic dark horror environment background in vertical 9:16 format, high resolution at least 1024x1792. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its painterly textured 2D graphic novel illustration, coherent architectural lines, detailed worn surfaces, soft volumetric lighting, restrained brushwork. NEW first-person POV environment seen through the eyes of a person physically inside the space, eye-level perspective, foreground elements close to lens at edges and deep vanishing point. Dark cinematic survival horror / zombie apocalypse setting at night, cold desaturated navy and blue-gray, subtle limited light accents, threatening atmospheric depth while retaining visible environmental detail. Do not show the viewer body, hands, weapons or flashlight; keep optional modular hand/item overlays separate for later compositing. No humans, zombies, creatures, silhouettes, corpses, gore, blood, glowing eyes, readable text, logos, UI, frames, grids or watermarks. One single immersive scene, no panels. Do not force a third-person stage or large empty lower third; authentic first-person framing is essential.
Environment: At eye level 1.6m, standing in a narrow ruined street at midnight looking toward a half-open quarantine barrier. Abandoned cars only at margins, broken windows, slack overhead wires, deep blue cold moonlight, one faint red warning beacon, low ground mist. Forward escape route readable.
